inlines.text: Estimate the mean from this grouped frequency table, giving your answer to 1 decimal place:

content.prompt: The grouped frequency table shows the lengths of time that a group of 150 people spent exercising last week.

answer.worked:
Class centres are the midpoints of the intervals.
$$\begin{aligned}cc_{6<t\leq8}&=\frac{6+8}{2}=7\\cc_{8<t\leq10}&=\frac{8+10}{2}=9\\5\times27&=135\\7\times24&=168\\9\times21&=189\\\Sigma ccf&=63+45+135+168+189\\\Sigma ccf&=600\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked: $$\begin{aligned}\overline{x}&=\frac{\Sigma ccf}{\Sigma f}\\\overline{x}&=\frac{600}{150}\\\overline{x}&=4\text{ hours}\end{aligned}$$

For each team, the number of goals scored in each game was recorded.
The frequency table shows the data for Team A.
The data for team B was analysed to create the box plot.

Compare the distributions of the number of goals scored by the two teams.
Support your answer with the construction of a box-plot for the data for Team A.

entries.expectedAnswer:
First, find the five-number summary for Team A (15 scores):
Minimum = 19
Maximum = 28
Median = the 8th score. Counting frequencies: 19(1), 21(1), 22(1), 23(1), 24(3) -> 7 scores. The 8th score is 26. So, Median = 26.
Q₁ is the median of the lower 7 scores. The 4th score is 23. So, Q₁ = 23.
Q₃ is the median of the upper 7 scores. The 12th score is 27. So, Q₃ = 27.
Alternatively you can use a calculator to find the five-number summary.
Comparing the distributions:
- Central Tendency: Team B generally scores more goals per game than Team A, as Team B has a higher median (27 compared to 26).
- Spread: Team A is more consistent in the number of goals scored per game. This is shown by the smaller Interquartile Range (27 − 23 = 4 for A, compared to 31 − 24 = 7 for B) and a smaller overall range (28 − 19 = 9 for A, compared to 35 − 21 = 14 for B).
- Skewness: Team A's distribution is negatively skewed (the left tail and box section are longer), whereas Team B's distribution is relatively symmetrical or slightly positively skewed.
